mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 110) and rising unemployment (UNRATE above 5.0%), the economy enters a contractionary regime where corporate profits fall, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 110 and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1150.0 thousand units for two consecutive months, it indicates a weakening housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is below 1150.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a tightening monetary policy coinciding with economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO falls for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer spending (RSAFS above 380,000 million dollars) and rising housing starts (HOUST above 1200.0 thousand units), the economy is in a late-cycle expansion phase that fuels corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS > 380,000 and HOUST > 1200.0.
